main_body: two-story half-timbered tavern building with tiled roof
top_band: orange-brown tiled roof slope from row 0 to row 43
evidence: The building shows a large foreshortened tiled roof top slope (rows 0-43) with chimney opening visible from above (rows 8-10), overhanging the vertical two-story south wall face (rows 44-95) with a distinct eave shadow at rows 44-45 and recessed door/windows.

style.evidence: While the roof has tiled blocks, they are repetitive rectangular grids lacking the rich scalloped per-tile highlights and organic variation of the Beodeul reference; the roof edges use a stark near-black outline (#0a0807), the plaster wall speckle is very faint compared to the reference's crisp plaster texture, and the chimney lacks brick texture.
